method: Whitened row-space projection; exact count conditioning; pooled prior variance sensitivity; Select 16 exact origin totals under each power and evaluate frozen selections under all three powers. Also choose a balanced set maximizing the worst marginal gain as a fraction of initial trace across the three laws. Score fixed sets with equicorrelated measurement errors (correlations -0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5), holding each measurement variance fixed at 0.25 and 1 times mean eligible origin variance. Resolve near ties by sorted zone order within 1e-12 of initial trace.
